args.subject: Spring campaign materials
args.body:
Attached are the hero images and approved banner variations for the Spring push. These are the final creative assets for the campaign; please pass them along to the vendor so they can update placements.

Notes: images optimized for mobile and desktop breakpoints. Licensing cleared through 05/31.

Shareable with the vendor.


Attached is the Spring campaign send calendar with dates, target segments, and channel mix. It includes timing for banner rotations and email sends. The vendor should receive this so they can coordinate execution.

This calendar was compiled from planning sessions on Feb 12 and Feb 18.

Shareable with the vendor.
